title: CD Projekt mystery games update: Yes, they're still happening, and no, not any time soon
summary: Maybe someday we'll find out what's going on with Sirius and Hadar, but it is not this day.
body: CD Projekt has a lot going on these days: The Witcher 4 , Cyberpunk 2 , a new Witcher 3 expansion and remaster , a remake of the original Witcher , probably some other stuff I've either forgotten or don't know about, and a couple of long-simmering mystery projects that are still only known by their codenames, Sirius and Hadar. You'd be forgiven for forgetting about them, given their low profile and drawn-out development times, but in today's H1 investors call , CD Projekt's vice president of investor relations Karolina Gnaś reassured everyone that they're still happening—just not anytime soon. Asked about Sirius, Gnaś mentioned the recent cuts to the development team , saying—as CD Projekt did when the layoffs happened—that the changes were made to meet "the current needs of the project." "Pre-production is ongoing, and at this stage we are focused on testing different solutions and ideas we develop," Gnaś said. "This project is very different from our other projects because it's focused on multiplayer. So there's a lot of learning and testing in this particular one." Sirius first came to light in 2021, when CD Projekt acquired The Molasses Flood , known for The Flame in the Flood…

title: How to sell silver in The Blood of Dawnwalker
summary: The Vrakhiri's reign makes it hard to find a merchant buying silver.
body: I had no trouble finding vendors to offload Coen's endless supply of low-value pilfered junk in Blood of Dawnwalker , but it took a few days to figure out how to sell silver . It makes sense that silver is considered contraband under vampire rule, so you have to find the right vendor to foist it on and complete a quick quest before adventuring south. Where can you sell silver in Blood of Dawnwalker? (Image credit: Rebel Wolves) You can sell silver in Svartrau City to the aptly named Silver Trader, but before you leave Coen's home in Laslea Glen, complete the Into the Den quest. It doesn't take long to slay the ravenous bear, and you need the intel uncovered by investigating what remains of its dinner. Any item with a white chalice icon is silver contraband Complete Into the Den, a quest that begins east of the Northern Foothill Head south to Svatrau City and speak with the Silver Trader Tell him you know he's dealing in silver, and he'll agree to trade In the name of RPG science, I tried heading to Svartrau immediately and skipping Into the Den, but the Silver Trader just tells Coen to get lost. You've gotta kill the bear, sorry. A note at the end of the quest points Coen to Svart…

title: How to drink Vrakhir blood in The Blood of Dawnwalker
summary: Chow down to unlock new vampiric abilities.
body: Finding Vrakhir blood in Blood of Dawnwalker might trip you up a bit if you're looking to unlock new abilities and generally mess about as a creature of the night. While you acquire most skills in the tree naturally as you drink blood and just generally be a vampire, some specific skills only become available when you "drink Vrakhir blood" and it's not clear exactly how. Below, I'll explain where to get it, plus how to unlock all Vrakhir blood-related abilities. How to drink Vrakhir blood in Blood of Dawnwalker If you anger one of the Vrakhiri boyars by messing with their operation, you'll get a chance to fight them (and drink their blood) Rebel Wolves You can also get Vrakhir blood by defeating certain Murohn bosses, such as the one in the Bad Blood quest in St. Tyna's Grove Rebel Wolves You can also get Vrakhir blood from some of Xanthe's quests Rebel Wolves The main way you drink Vrakhir blood is by defeating the game's Vrakhir bosses , namely, Ambrus, Bakir, and Xanthe, and then choosing to drink from them. Supping the blood of these three vampires unlocks different abilities, namely: Ambrus - Scarlet Shield Bakir - Shadowstorm Xanthe - Blood Surge Unlike earning skills by con…

title: How to complete The Gilded Gauntlet in The Blood of Dawnwalker
summary: Face Ambrus in (im)mortal combat
body: Facing Ambrus in Blood of Dawnwalker 's The Gilded Gauntlet quest is likely the first fight you'll encounter with one of Brencis's boyars. After all, this foppish Vrakhiri rules over the provinces you start exploring immediately after you leave Laslea, and is responsible for procuring blood from Vale Sangora's, often unwilling, subjects. As with any of the boyar fights, there are different routes you can take to defeating them, so here are the approaches you can take, plus the consequences that each will have. How to complete The Gilded Gauntlet in Blood of Dawnwalker You can start The Gilded Gauntlet in Maragir after you anger Ambrus enough Rebel Wolves Codric's servant will ask you to come meet her master Rebel Wolves You can poison Ambrus through Codric's The Bittersweet Toast quest, or just fight Ambrus normally Rebel Wolves Unlike Xanthe and Bakar, no one will come to meet you when you anger Ambrus. Instead, you need to head to Maragir in the Maragir Wealds, where you'll find a new ? symbol has popped up. You'll discover that Ambrus has crucified some villagers to get your attention and left a note challenging you to a duel at the ruined castle above the town come nightfall. …

title: How to complete Echoes of Silenced Bells in The Blood of Dawnwalker
summary: And whether you should burn the notes.
body: The Echoes of Silenced Bells quest in Blood of Dawnwalker is one of the few you receive when you leave Laslea and step out into the big wide world. Though quite far south in the St. Tyna's Grove region, once you make your way there, you'll have to help Anca enter St. Tyna's Convent, where she used to be a nun, and track down books that might arm you with knowledge to defeat the Vrahkir. Here's how to complete it, plus the impact of each choice at the end. How to complete Echoes of Silenced Bells in Blood of Dawnwalker The initial stages of this quest are pretty simple. You meet with Anca, head to St. Tyna's Convent, encounter a zombified nun—what? Oh yes, all of the nuns at the convent have been mysteriously turned into self-reviving zombies. The crux of the quest comes after you escape a pack of them and head outside to overlook the convent courtyard. You have to navigate this central compound and find a way to get Anca safely to the library. Before I explain them, take note: make sure to grab the Saint's Tibia item from the corpse below the ladder in the west of the area, as this is actually used in another later quest. Otherwise, here are the two approaches you can take: 1. Hel…

title: Should you spare Xanthe in The Blood of Dawnwalker?
summary: Make a deal with this ancient Vrakhiri or send her packing.
body: Deciding whether to spare Xanthe and make a deal in Blood of Dawnwalker is a really tough choice. On the one hand, she's an evil ancient vampire who kidnapped and killed a bunch of innocent women, but she was only using Brencis as a tool of convenience. That might be enough for you to ponder what advantage an alliance with her could bring. Obviously, this guide will contain spoilers for Xanthe's The Cycle of Love quest , but otherwise, here's the outcome if you spare her. Should you spare Xanthe in Blood of Dawnwalker? Killing Xanthe will make your castle assault a bit harder Rebel Wolves If you kill Xanthe you'll also have to decide Chariklea's fate Rebel Wolves The main impact of sparing Xanthe in her mansion, when you defeat her during The Cycle of Love quest, is that during the final assault on Griefberg Castle: You won't have to fight any Blood Guard enemies. Xanthe will meet you in the castle and offer some advice. You won't have to go through the nightmare sequence you get if you kill Xanthe. Is this worth it for letting the Vrakhiri live? Not really. If you kill Xanthe, you won't have to fight her in the castle either, so the only real advantage allying with her gives you …

title: How to beat the Ravenous Bear and complete Into the Den in The Blood of Dawnwalker
summary: Kill this hangry boss and find the flat stone marked with X.
body: Fighting the Ravenous Bear is an early combat challenge in Blood of Dawnwalker 's prologue, but mainly because you don't have many skills or decent equipment yet, which turns the fight into a slog. After you do defeat it, you'll also have to track down a treasure as part of the Into the Den quest. I'll run through how to do both below. How to beat the Ravenous Bear in Blood of Dawnwalker The Ravenous Bear is the most challenging early boss you can encounter near Laslea. Here are some tips to beat it, plus a video of me fighting the bear above so you can see the strategy in action: Get a better sword : The fight will be over faster if you get a decent weapon. I recommend heading across to the other side of the lake, looking for the big tree with the wolves, and completing the Deep Down quest. This will get you the Undead Warrior's Sword, which is a nice upgrade over what you had. Parry its regular attacks, but dodge to the side of its red unblockable ones : Parrying is better in this fight because you're less likely to run out stamina (which dodging consumes), so you can keep attacking. When the bear attacks with a red skull, dodge to the side, rather than away. This will give you …

title: All Swordmastery ability manual locations in The Blood of Dawnwalker
summary: Unlock these blade skills early.
body: Tracking down Swordmastery manuals in Blood of Dawnwalker will give you more abilities to use when fighting in your human form. While the regular skill manuals appear to be random, the actual ability manuals have fixed locations, so you can track them down whenever you want. Below, I've included manual locations for all the Swordmastery abilities in the optimal order for grabbing them. All Swordmastery ability locations There are seven Swordmastery abilities in Blood of Dawnwalker. You start with Dirty Trick already unlocked, but you can get the others through certain quests or by finding manuals, usually in Bandit Camps, Soldier Camps, or purchase via Swordmastery trainers. The trainers I know of are: Merchant Location Ursul Complete the Ambrus Prisoners: Lucky Crossing quest north of Svartrau and then head to Ursul's camp. Ocha This Uriashi sword teacher is only unlocked through certain endings in The Heart Wants What The Heart Wants quest in Svartrau. Drogos Unlocked through the Manumit questline that starts with The Firebrand, Shadows in the Woods, and then Where Loyalty Lies . You'll need additional manuals to upgrade abilities past Level 1, so I've included the different way…

title: All Witchcraft ability manual locations in The Blood of Dawnwalker
summary: Learn these hexes to confound your enemies.
body: Finding Witchcraft manuals really helps make Blood of Dawnwalker 's human combat a lot of fun. These hexes can summon a murder of crows, set enemy blood ablaze, or even protect and reflect against a single instance of damage. The catch, however, is that you'll have to track down skill manuals to unlock them. I'll run through where to find them all below and provide a list of all the Witchcraft vendors you can buy manuals from. All Witchcraft ability locations There are ten Witchcraft abilities, but you'll unlock Compel Soul, Astral Communion, Burning Blood, and Mercurial Fervour from Anca towards the end of the prologue. You'll have to find manuals to unlock the other six and level them all, which you can usually get via completing Ancient Circles, Haunted Sites, or any of the Pilgrimage of Power quests. You can also find them in bookcases, or purchase them from any of the following Witchcraft merchants: Merchant Location Anca You unlock her as a vendor at the Crossroads Inn in St. Tyna's Grove after you complete Echoes of Silenced Bells . Vera Located in the east of Briar Sloughs' swamp, southeast of Mert's Mill. Peddler of Wonders Located in the Midden, the ruined district to th…

title: Full prologue walkthrough and quest order for The Blood of Dawnwalker
summary: Use this ideal quest order to get the least bloody mass because there's not enough time to do it all and lives are on the line.
body: How time works Time-sensitive quests are marked with a clock 🕑 in your quest log. There are eight time segments each day (and eight each night). Quests that use up time have an hourglass symbol ⏳ and number to indicate how many segments they use. ⚠️ Getting caught stealing will waste four time segments with the guard. ⚠️ Be careful about learning skills at shrines during the prologue; some use up time to unlock. Full prologue walkthrough Your first choice in the prologue is whether Coen should force-feed his mother Esme at his father Pieter's direction. TL;DR: this choice doesn't have any long term impact but after that you'll need to start managing your time as the prologue begins in earnest. Prologue quest order: the best route (Image credit: Rebel Wolves) Time segment Quests 1 Morning Live Bait 2 Morning Dead Drop Withering Away 3 Noon (Optional) Page-Turner, or substitute with Into The Den in the afternoon 4 Noon Withering Away part 2 5 Afternoon Enter Not If A Tree Falls Deep Down 6 Afternoon Blasphemy 7 Evening Disturbed 8 Evening Like Father, Like Son Which quests should you skip? title: How to prepare Anca's recipe in The Blood of Dawnwalker
summary: Fix your mother's medicine with the right steps.
body: During Blood of Dawnwalker 's main prologue quest, Withering Away, you'll have to prepare Anca's recipe into a medicine for your mother's anxiety, helping her overcome her fear to attend the Blood Mass that evening. Anca gives you a page of instructions to follow, but the tricksy game won't let you view them while making the medicine. This means you're up a creek if you haven't already memorised them, and don't want to potentially load a save in the distant past just to read a sheet of paper. I'll include the instructions below, along with the friendly advice that it is very important that you make this medicine correctly. How to prepare Anca's recipe in Blood of Dawnwalker Use hot water Rebel Wolves Add three spoonfuls of herbs Rebel Wolves Once you arrive back at the house, your father will ask you to prepare the medicine for your mother. Unfortunately, you can't read the recipe at this point, so you have to have it memorised, or just follow the instructions below: Choose the 'Use hot water' option Choose the 'Add three spoonfuls of herbs' option This follows Anca's instructions that she gave you, and will help make the correct medicine for Esme so she can have a slightly more r…

title: Can you beat Brencis in The Blood of Dawnwalker's prologue?
summary: Face the big bad a little earlier than expected.
body: At the end of Blood of Dawnwalker 's prologue, you'll fight Brencis , the Knyaz of Vale Sangora, and quite obviously the game's main antagonist. It's one of those classic "you're not supposed to win this" boss fights, since losing to him plays a cutscene and continues the story. But where there's a will, there's a way. Below I'll explain what happens if you beat Brencis, provide a video of fighting him, and the outcome. Be warned, this contains spoilers for some aspects of the game's ending sequence. Can you beat Brencis in Blood of Dawnwalker's prologue? The answer to this is a little complex—both yes and probably no. You can beat Brencis in your first fight with him provided you've learnt how to Perfect Block and dodge, though it will take a little while. After you beat Brencis, a cutscene will play in which he effectively pulls you into hell and reveals his true form, Brencis, Grotesque Ascendant (also the final boss). Since this is still a boss fight, you theoretically should be able to beat it, but even after acquiring the strongest equipment I could on the first day, you do an incredibly small amount of damage to him, and one hit from him will invariably kill you, even if yo…

title: Every romancable character in The Blood of Dawnwalker and how to have them fall fang over heels for Coen
summary: Coen has three options for a bat romance.
body: Coen is certainly going through it, but Blood of Dawnwalker offers a smidge of succor by not making him face the onslaught of horrors alone. You've got three potential romance options for him—one of which seems more 'canonical' than the rest—and the vampy RPG doesn't make you choose just one. When it comes to games like this, I love to kiss and tell. So here are all three of your options for love in a breezy Blood of Dawnwalker romance guide . Spoiler warning: While we keep details as minimal as possible, this guide follows all three romance plots through the end of the game. That includes details on how to ensure your lover shows up in the epilogue, so keep that in mind before you go skimming through the text. How romance works in The Blood of Dawnwalker The Blood of Dawnwalker has three romanceable characters: Anca, Lacra, and Crake. Coen isn't limited to just one partner either, so don't fret over fumbling your shot. RPG veterans won't find much out of the ordinary when it comes to wooing your fantasy lover, but here's the gist of how romance works in Blood of Dawnwalker: The most important step is knowing where to start each romance and prioritizing chances to flirt with your …

title: I've spent over 80 hours in The Blood of Dawnwalker—here are my top 20 quick tips to survive Vale Sangora
summary: Help Coen rescue his family from Vrakhiri clutches.
body: Searching for some Blood of Dawnwalker tips ? Deciding what to do first in this vampiric RPG can be tough, especially if you're the kind of person who's paralysed by indecision when a game gives you a lot of freedom. You've got 30 days to save your family: everything else is pretty much anyone's game. (Image credit: Rebel Wolves) There's no right or wrong answer. You can't really fail The Blood of Dawnwalker either, depending on how you define failure. While its time constraints form a guideline and structure to follow, where to spend that time is entirely down to you. Here's my best advice from spending 80 hours with the game, testing its many quests and choices. 1. Use the shield icon to Perfect Block Rather than timing your block to the enemy's swing, wait for when the shield turns orange on the directional indicator. Also unlock Perfect Riposte for a guaranteed crit afterwards. 2. Take time to level up I barely levelled in my run because I was worried about time and I made it to the end of the story with a whole 15 days left. Don't be like me. 3. Killing enemies is time-efficient Murdering enemies you find, particularly wolves, boar, and bear bosses in the woods, is an extreme…

title: How to save Vlad in The Blood of Dawnwalker
summary: Can you control yourself?
body: If you're curious whether you can save Vlad in Blood of Dawnwalker , chances are you've probably just killed him. Unable to resist your newly-gained vampiric urges, you chomped his neck and drank his blood, and the game didn't give you a choice in the matter. Well, there is a way Vlad can survive your encounter after he leaves the burning house, towards the end of the prologue. Obviously, this will contain spoilers for this final section of the prologue , so leave 10 seconds ago if you're here by accident. How to save Vlad in Blood of Dawnwalker Make sure to beat the miniboss with at least one health segment left Rebel Wolves This will allow you to control the hunger when you speak to Vlad Rebel Wolves If you want Vlad to survive the conversation you two have when he exits the burning house, you need to have more than one health segment . Since health is blood for vampires, when you're one segment or below, you're hungry, which impacts your conversations with human characters, i.e. makes you want to eat them. If you are below one segment when you convince Vlad to leave the burning house, you're unable to resist your hunger and you kill him. If you're above one segment, though, you…

title: Should you let Anca use The Font in The Blood of Dawnwalker?
summary: Cleanse the herbalist's curse or use it yourself.
body: Choosing whether to let Anca use The Font or claim it for yourself in Blood of Dawnwalker is tough. On the one hand, you committed a lot of time to fighting your way through an ancient ruin and it'd be nice to have something to show for it. On the other hand, you've got Anca's fate to consider. This guide will contain spoilers for Anca's questline , plus the effect of this choice. All that said, here's the impact of each option. Should you let Anca use The Font in Blood of Dawnwalker? (Image credit: Rebel Wolves) When you arrive in the chamber of The Font in Anca's Stronger Than Achilles quest, you'll find there's only enough tasty blood left for either you or Anca. You'll be given three choices: "If it's alright with you - I'll use it." "Go ahead. Make what you will with it." "We should destroy it." I'll run through each decision and outcome below. 1. Coen uses The Font If Coen uses it he gains the Font of Life health regeneration perk when human (Image credit: Rebel Wolves) If you use the blood yourself, you'll gain the Font of Life passive, which regenerates human health during the day. This is a pretty decent perk, especially when Witchcraft abilities cost HP, but it's worth n…

title: How to complete The Heart Wants What It Wants in The Blood of Dawnwalker
summary: Help Ocha and Nora find a new life.
body: When you stumble on The Heart Wants What It Wants in a random tavern in Blood of Dawnwalker , you might be surprised by how complex this quest can be in terms of its outcomes. The actual meat of the quest, helping an Uriashi, Ocha, and her friend, Nora, escape the clutches of Svartrau's crime lord, is pretty simple, but it can end in many different ways. Here's how to complete the quest, plus its different outcomes based on your choices. How to complete The Heart Wants What It Wants in Blood of Dawnwalker Use vampiric powers to get onto the balcony at night and steal Andrei's ring from his desk Rebel Wolves The ring is the correct memento for Ocha's spell Rebel Wolves Open the pig pen to distract the guard then draw the hex on the window Rebel Wolves If you go downstairs or give Ocha the wrong item, you'll have to kill Andrei, which impacts the overall outcome Rebel Wolves Once you acquire the quest from Ocha and Nora at the Altenmarkt inn, follow the map marker to Andrei's butcher shop, and enter via the balcony on the upper floor using your vampire powers. In the upper room you'll find three different mementos for Ocha's amnesia spell: a ring, a pendant, and a cleaver. The memen…

title: How to free Mert in The Blood of Dawnwalker
summary: Complete Under Watchful Eyes without battling through the entire fort.
body: Finding a way to free Mert in Blood of Dawnwalker 's Under Watchful Eyes quest took me a while to work out. At first, I slaughtered the entire fort, but after such a slog of a fight I realised there must be a better way to do it—turns out there is. You can take a sneakier route at nighttime which drastically reduces the number of soldiers you have to kill. In my video runthrough of it below, I also show how to reduce the number of fights even further with some tactically-employed Voracious Bites. Here's how to free Mert without murdering the fort. How to free Mert without killing everyone in Stoneward Post There's an obvious approach to freeing Mert in Under Watchful Eyes, and that's killing every soldier in the fort, but this is understandably quite tricky. There is a sneakier route you can take via a back door instead which will really cut down the number of goons you've got to put down. You can avoid the two-on-one fight in Friedo's office by following my exact route in the video above. To do it, you need to purchase the Shadow Dweller and Dimension Reach upgrades in the Vampirism tree so you can take a shortcut up to the battlements. These are generally very handy upgrades, th…

title: How to complete Blasphemy in The Blood of Dawnwalker
summary: Help Gremla track down the stolen tapestry before nightfall.
body: The Blasphemy quest is one of the most impactful in Blood of Dawnwalker 's prologue, since it impacts the Blood Mass at the end of the day. When you find Gremla, bemoaning the theft of her tapestry, she explains that she took on that task of weaving a vampiric banner for the Knyaz, and that Brencis won't be pleased if she can't get it back. It's easy enough to see the writing on the wall as to the outcome for not completing this one. However, the quest's second section, which sees you searching for the culprit, is actually quite tough. Below, I'll run through the whole quest, plus I've included details as to the outcome and rewards for getting Gremla's tapestry back, or keeping the thief's secret. How to complete Blasphemy in Blood of Dawnwalker Investigate the loom in Gremla's house Rebel Wolves Investigate the footprints and walking stick trail leading to the torn scrap Rebel Wolves Examine the torn scrap and find the blood stain Rebel Wolves After you speak to Gremla at her house in Laslea, you need to use Focus Mode (right click) to do some investigating: Use Focus Mode to inspect the weaving loom in her house Inspect the trail of footprints and the cane trail around the side …

title: How to complete Where Loyalty Lies in The Blood of Dawnwalker
summary: Join the Manumits by increasing your infamy.
body: Completing Where Loyalty Lies is the first big step in aligning yourself with a faction in Blood of Dawnwalker . Until now, you've likely been taking the fight to Brencis yourself, though maybe you decided to free Mert out of the goodness of your heart. But to join the Manumits, you'll have to prove your commitment to the cause by raising your infamy, a system you may not have interacted with much until now. How to complete Where Loyalty Lies in Blood of Dawnwalker Angering and defeating a Vrakhiri boyar (like Ambrus) is a great way to earn infamy Rebel Wolves Crushing Soldier Camps is a very time-effective way of getting infamy since they only cost one cycle Rebel Wolves The same goes for the Soldier Pickets that start appearing when you reach infamy Level 2 Rebel Wolves You'll need to raise your infamy level to Notorious in order to join the Manumits, which is the fourth (IV) level on the court's infamy track, which you can see in the 'Court' tab of the menu. Your best bet for raising infamy is: Complete named Vrakhir quests in any of the regions , such as Ambrus's Cellars, Ambrus's Transports, Ambrus's Collectors, or Ambrus's Prisoners, all of which are available in the regions…

title: Should you force feed Esme in The Blood of Dawnwalker?
summary: Get some scran in Coen's mum.
body: Deciding whether to force feed Coen's mum in Blood of Dawnwalker is one of the initial choices you'll encounter, but if you're like me, you may pause over it a while wondering how much it's going to impact. The game's prologue has only just started in earnest, and this is the first proper decision you encounter after all. So, here's what happens based on either choice and which I recommend picking. Should you force feed Coen's mum in Blood of Dawnwalker? Trying to force feed Esme is indeed bad (Image credit: Rebel Wolves) While Esme indeed does need to eat—how else is she going to make lots of lovely blood for mass in the evening—force feeding her doesn't help the situation. If you choose the "Alright. Let's try" option, Coen will pick up the spoon and try to force feed Esme, but this results in her smacking the spoon aside and then essentially bursting into tears, leaving your dad, Pieter, feeling very sorry about what he tried to do. Choosing the "I won't feed her against her will" option instead sees your father try to force feed her, but she also still bats the spoon out of his hand. It's the same result, but this way she at least seems less distressed with the outcome. This d…

title: Should you invite Ambrus in The Blood of Dawnwalker?
summary: Send this Vrakhir to hell or keep him around.
body: Deciding whether to invite Ambrus in is a tough choice in Blood of Dawnwalker , especially as you don't really know what "invite" means in this context. This rogue-ish Vrakhir certainly deserves hell for all the atrocities he committed bleeding Vale Sangora's subjects, but maybe there's more to him than meets the eye. Obviously, this guide will contain spoilers as to the immediate and eventual impact of this choice, so leave now if you don't want to know. Should you invite Ambrus in Blood of Dawnwalker? You'll have to decide whether to invite Ambrus if you drink his blood (Image credit: Rebel Wolves) If you invite Ambrus in, the main consequence is that he'll talk to you throughout the rest of the game . I'm not talking full blown dialogue, but he'll essentially make comments as a voice inside your head, about stuff you're doing, such as when you make a choice, or in combat. In fact, there's one Ambrus comment at a particular moment (I won't spoil it) that made me laugh so much I consider it well worth inviting him just for that. Does it have any consequences? Basically, no. The main impact is that Ambrus will help you a bit in the final boss, but he can also be turned against you…

title: How to complete Letters to Lunka in The Blood of Dawnwalker
summary: Help the Sanzhani to send secret messages to Lunka.
body: The Letters to Lunka quest in Blood of Dawnwalker is a sneaky way to get a bit more intel about what's happening with Coen's family in Griefberg Castle. As you likely discovered in the Good Home quest, these fairies can spirit themselves into the dungeon and whisper messages in Lunka's ear. If you help out the Sanzhani around the map, you can ask all remaining questions—here's how it works. How to complete Letters to Lunka in Blood of Dawnwalker You can send one message to Lunka for each Sanzhani you help (Image credit: Rebel Wolves) After you finish the Good Home quest and accept your reward of sending your first letter to Lunka, you can send four more letters, one per Sanzhani quest you complete around Vale Sangora. title: CD Projekt says it never considered charging Witcher 3 owners for the remastered edition: 'It was never a question we asked ourselves'
summary: The Songs of the Past expansion will make money, but the remastered Witcher 3 is a gift.
body: These are big days for The Witcher 3 : It's not only getting a full-on story expansion in 2027, a remaster of the base game is also coming later this month. Even better, anyone who owns the original Witcher 3 will get the remaster for free. That's pretty generous as these things go, but in an interview with The Game Business , CD Projekt co-CEO Michał Nowakowski said there was never any thought of doing it differently. "It was never a question we asked ourselves," Nowakowski said. "We were going deeper into the development of Songs of the Past with Fool's Theory, and we started chatting: 'Why don't we make the game more modern? Everything felt like it was developed 10 years ago.' Because it was developed more than 10 years ago. "We started chatting about what we could do to improve it. It started with small things and then it turned into this larger project, and we suddenly realized we had a remaster on our hands." There's little doubt that existing Witcher 3 owners would've been willing to pony up for a modernized version of the game, especially with a new expansion on the way, but "we never thought about it this way," Nowakowski said. The Songs of the Past expansion is where CD …

title: 'Can I cry?': Stalker 2 devs say its 2.0 update's engine overhaul was a nightmare—but worth the effort
summary: That's going to cause some anomalies.
body: Earlier this month, Stalker 2 received a massive version 2.0 update to accompany the launch of its Cost of Hope expansion. Our Joshua Wolens says that—for those of us who've been patiently holding off while Stalker 2 finds a steady footing— it's the update that we've been waiting for , thanks in large part to developer GSC Game World's Herculean undertaking of updating its engine from Unreal 5.1 to Unreal 5.5.4. That effort, it seems, was well spent. But while they're proud of the results, GSC told PC Gamer in an interview at this year's Gamescom that the process of overhauling the game's engine after launch was a bit of a nightmare. (Image credit: GSC Game World) When asked how that process went, GSC Game world COO and head of creative Maria Grygorovych responded with a question of her own: "Can I cry?" While an engine overhaul is a massive task for any game project, she said it was particularly involved in Stalker 2's case. "It was extremely hard because our [implementation of Unreal 5.1] was extremely customized. We had so much of our own code. It cost an enormous amount of time," she said. "If you work closer to the vanilla version, it's much easier. It depends on the process …

title: 30,000 people line up 24 hours early to play the final Wardogs closed beta, developer responds: 'YOU PEOPLE ARE CRAZY'
summary: Wardogs is holding one more closed beta before launch.
body: The hottest FPS in town, Wardogs , is holding one last beta before it hits early access from September 3 to 6. Buzz for the 100-player milsim has far eclipsed the expectations of developer Bulkhead, who says Wardogs has surpassed a million wishlists on Steam. Bulkhead was planning to keep the final beta a surprise drop for its upcoming FPS Games Show livestream, but decided to spill the beans itself after fans got the wrong idea from teasers. The popular theory was that Bulkhead was preparing an open beta that anyone could join, but game director Joe Brammer clarified on X this week that you'll need to pre-order for $40 to get in, and explained why: "In this situation, what we’re doing is starting a controlled fire and seeing what burns the fastest to help us prevent and manage a blaze if one does occur in the future,' Brammer said. "If we open the flood gates, very very few systems hold up to the numbers we hit in our first beta, having 100,000 players spam a queue, isn’t that useful to us. What we want to know is really boring stuff, like “what happens when over 100k players are in the server browser, and everyone is clicking on servers." Basically, Bulkhead is treating the beta…

title: Double Fine's famous game jam returns with 26 new ideas and a promise to make Brutal Legend 2, if its Kickstarter stretch goal is met
summary: The Amnesia Fortnight Kickstarter blew past its goal in just two days, but getting a new Brutal Legend is going to be a whole different pile of money
body: One happy upside to Double Fine's newly-regained independence is the return of Amnesia Fortnight , the semi-regular in-house game jam in which everyone stops what they're doing and spends two weeks pitching and developing prototypes for new games. The 2026 edition of the event—seemingly the first since Microsoft acquired Double Fine in 2019—launched a Kickstarter campaign on August 31, and its $400,000 goal has already been surpassed. The Amnesia Fortnight crowdfunding campaign serves two purposes. It raises money for Double Fine, which is good, but it also grants power : Just like in a real democracy, people who are willing to spend money will get to sway the process in voting for which of the 26 game pitches actually get made, and the more you spend the more influence you have. At the $15 tier, for instance, your vote only counts for half, but at $30 you get a full vote—and if you go up to $60, your vote is doubled—a single vote cast counts for two! What a great system. Voting will close on September 6, following the conclusion of PAX, after which the Amnesia Fortnight game jam actually begins: Over the following two weeks, the top four finalists will be built into playable demo…

body: I don't like waging into gaming romance wars—things got a bit dicey with Ada and Claire—but it seems that I am yet to learn my lesson because here I am again with the news that Geralt's one true love isn't Yennifer or Triss, it's his trusty and talkative bard, Dandelion. title: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn turns the best Mass Effect mission into an entire game
summary: And makes it better.
body: I played an hour of The Expanse: Osiris Reborn at Gamescom, and despite doing it in a sweltering room with a dev judging me for every death, I came away pretty impressed. It deserves to stand on its own merits, but unfortunately I am about to talk about Mass Effect quite a lot—it's hard not to. Like the BioWare of old, Owlcat is an isometric CRPG developer now trying its hand at a cinematic third-person RPG, which turns into a cover-heavy squad-based shooter when the guns come out. Mass Effect, then, is an obvious point of comparison. (Image credit: Owlcat Games) But it's a comparison that serves The Expanse well, because in the short time I played it, I saw a multitude of ways in which it has improved upon BioWare's formula. How it handles exploration, combat and crew interactions makes me think, if it can keep it up, that The Expanse is going to make Mass Effect diehards extremely happy, without leaving Owlcat's CRPG fans out in the cold. We already wrote about The Expanse's hi-tech fights after checking it out in April. title: SteamDB changes hands to Nexus Mods, which means it 'needs to make money' now—but there won't be ads or paywalls
summary: "Nothing you know and use today is getting taken away and sold back to you."
body: SteamDB is an excellent resource—as someone who occasionally has to pull up a game's concurrent numbers or pricing to make a point, I'd be lying if I said I haven't used it in a professional capacity. What's been more staggering is its status as a site run entirely on donations. Well, that's ending soon. The site's founder, xPaw, has decided to move on due to a feeling of burnout. In their full statement , they write: "After Covid and with the rise of AI, the internet we once loved is gone, and with it my passion. I have started experiencing burnout with the project, but I powered through. "A few years ago I tried to find someone to continue the project, but I couldn't find a team that I was confident in, so I decided to keep going by myself. Steam keeps growing, in terms of games, players, and the number of new features being added. It's hard to keep on top of this alone, and the mental load has only kept increasing, and in good conscience I cannot continue like this." The buyers in question? summary: Same vibes, different look.
body: Persona 5 was so damn successful, it's unsurprising that Atlus has spent the years since A) milking the hell out of it and B) using its incredibly stylish visuals as a template to remake the other two games in its modern trilogy. Persona 3 Reload was the first utilisation of that template, and now we're doing it all over again with Persona 4 Revival. Its cast of characters un-chibified, ready to be unleashed upon a far more highly detailed rendition of the cosy town of Inaba. (Image credit: Atlus) Honestly, I was a little worried sitting down to play Persona 4 Revival at Gamescom . Its predecessor, Persona 4 Golden, was my introduction to the series and hugely formative for me. It's a game I hold incredibly close to my heart, one I've played countless times over. I've been carrying around this gnawing feeling that Atlus' ongoing attempts to bring a cohesive art style to the series was going to be its undoing. Would Revival still feel like the Persona 4 I know and love? I'm incredibly relieved to say that the answer to that is: it absolutely does. title: Was Geralt's voice actor inspired by Henry Cavill's take on him in The Witcher series? 'No, because we were first'
summary: "I still haven't got a call for a cameo," says Dandelion VA John Schwab.
body: It's often said that good artists borrow, and great artists steal. And given Doug Cockle, the voice actor for Geralt of Rivia in The Witcher 3 , has been in the rare position of getting to see a character he's played for years in videogames debut on streamed TV, portrayed for a stint by Henry Cavill (and now Liam Hemsworth ), you might wonder if he has taken any notes. "No," he tells PC Gamer's Joshua Wolens at Gamescom 2026 . "Because we were first." John Schwab, voice actor for the longtime friend of Geralt, Dandelion, joins in with some friendly ribbing of Netflix: "And I still haven't got a call for a cameo. Have you?" he asks Cockle. "No!" Cockle replies, to which Schwab emphatically says: "Come on, guys!" Cockle does say that he's asked the showrunners—though it's unclear if this is a joke or not—to "bring me in every episode. Just put me in the background. Pull a Stan Lee or something, y'know? Pull a Stan Lee. But did they do it? No." Despite the friendly elbows going on, though, Schwab is quick to give his compliments: "I like Dandelion, I like Jaskier, he's a fun guy. title: After playing a bit of Lego Skylines, it seems like a city builder for people who care less about traffic jams and more about decorating
summary: A short preview revealed a cozy and calm builder with some gorgeous views.
body: It makes so much sense I can't believe it didn't happen years ago: as revealed at Gamescom last week, Lego is finally fulfilling its destiny by making a city builder . And I'm happy to say I got my eager hands on an early build of Lego Skylines for a little preview. I do want to make this clear: the preview build I played was very short, with only about 35 minutes of playtime. It was almost entirely focused on building one small neighborhood, with the population maxing out at around 50 residents by the end of the preview. That's not quite long enough, or big enough, to get a real feel for a city builder. But what's here is immediately appealing. The little Lego world I worked on was simply lovely. Click to build a house and it'll quickly be constructed in a colorful shower of Lego bricks falling from the sky and piling up into a cozy-looking little home. Bulldoze a mistake and the building will collapse into a heap of plastic bricks on the ground. The cute animations and cheery visuals are exactly what I'd hoped for when I saw the game's trailer last week, and again made me wonder why Lego didn't make a city builder years ago. title: 30,000 games are either Steam Deck verified or at least 'playable' on Valve's handheld
summary: Hands on, and on the go.
body: Valve's handheld launched in February 2022, opening the door to playing your Steam library on the go. Now, almost half a decade later, 30,000 games either enjoy the green stamp of being Steam Deck verified, or are at least considered 'playable.' According to the latest numbers from SteamDB that breaks down to 8,964 Steam Deck Verified games and 21,083 games considered 'playable' on the handheld (via Gaming On Linux ). That's a big jump from the 3,000 games either Verified or Playable back in May 2022 . 'Verified' means your game of choice should work great on the Steam Deck from first boot, whereas 'Playable' games require either some finagling or adjustments for the best experience. Steam Deck verification is also joined by similar compatibility checks for the Steam Machine , the soon-to-be-released Steam Frame , and SteamOS more broadly. I make the whole thing sound straightforward, but it's worth noting that the Steam Deck's full verification criteria can present developers with confusing hoops to jump through .
